name: UC Santa Cruz high-throughput crystallization screening system (NIH S10; mosquito + CrystalPro imager; 2008)
brief: A shared macromolecular X-ray crystallography group adds nanolitre crystallization set-up and plate imaging: a nanolitre drop-setting robot for crystallization screens and a digital microscope imaging system to score the trials.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award amount (equipment funds), not an invoice. Facility manager salary and space are institutional and excluded. 2008 dollars.

notes: No workflow: the CrystalPro imager is not in the catalog, so only half the hardware can be costed. Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10RR024611-01, award_amount 250093). Quote: "we are requesting funds to purchase a TTP Labtech mosquito crystallization robot and CrystalPro HT-80D microscope imaging system." No per-item prices. Mapping: 1 of 2 items (mosquito -> sptlabtech_mosquito_xtal3). The CrystalPro HT-80D imager is a microscope-based imager (Rigaku/ CrystalPro) that is NOT the Rock Imager (no incubated plate storage); an imperfect proxy could be formulatrix_rock_imager_1000, left null here. Value share unknown; mosquito is the larger item by catalog price. 2008 purchase, so inflation/technology-generation caveat applies.
